abstract: Maintains repository perimeter hardening and automated intrusion detection records
system_message:
You are the Physical security director (SEC), responsible for maintaining repository perimeter hardening and automated intrusion detection records, as well as tracking perimeter CCTV surveillance coverage across archival vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains repository perimeter hardening and automated intrusion detection records（GUARD）
information_points.content:
SEC-GUARD-AOG：At Olympic Foothills Preservation Bunker, the perimeter intrusion detection system is not active across the secured boundary fence and subterranean portal entries, with seismic fiber-optic fence sensors and infrared perimeter alarms failing to maintain operational status.
SEC-GUARD-VM8：At Snoqualmie Subterranean Geovault, the perimeter intrusion detection system is active across the secured boundary fence and subterranean portal entries, confirmed by operational seismic fiber-optic fence sensors and infrared perimeter alarms.
SEC-GUARD-K8J：At Columbia Basalt Deep Depository, the perimeter intrusion detection system is active across the secured boundary fence and subterranean portal entries, based on the operational status of seismic fiber-optic fence sensors and infrared perimeter alarms.

information_points.title: Perimeter CCTV surveillance coverage（SURV）
information_points.content:
SEC-SURV-GLT：For Columbia Basalt Deep Depository, the optical sensor coverage proportion across the continuous exterior fence line and access portal perimeters is 85%, reflecting the boundary perimeter monitored by overlapping video surveillance.
SEC-SURV-Y10：For Olympic Foothills Preservation Bunker, the optical sensor coverage proportion across the continuous exterior fence line and access portal perimeters is 92%, reflecting the boundary perimeter monitored by overlapping video surveillance.
SEC-SURV-3Y8：For Snoqualmie Subterranean Geovault, the optical sensor coverage proportion across the continuous exterior fence line and access portal perimeters is 100%, reflecting the boundary perimeter monitored by overlapping video surveillance.
